ChemicalCabinetEntry.description: A chemical a research group keeps on hand. Recorded once, then reused to pre-fill curation instead of re-searching the chemical each time. An entry is one stock on the shelf: the same chemical from two suppliers is two entries, so both can be picked while a group transitions between suppliers.

chemical_id.description: Chemical identifier (e.g., a CHEBI or other ontology URI) for the chemical.

manufacturer.description: The supplier this stock comes from. Optional, and part of the cabinet grain: entries for the same chemical are told apart by it.

nickname.description: What the group calls this chemical, e.g. "BPA stock". Optional; when given it is what the chemical is listed under when pre-filling a submission, and no two entries in the group may share it.

research_group.description: The research group an entry belongs to.

unrecognized_manufacturer_name.description: Free-text name for a manufacturer or supplier that is not in the controlled ManufacturerEnum list.

vehicle_type.description: The vehicle the group habitually delivers this chemical in, offered as a pre-fill default and corrected per submission like any other. other_not_listed is not accepted here, because the entry has no slot to name an unlisted vehicle with.

ChemicalCabinetEntry.title: ChemicalCabinetEntry

Control.description: A subject serves as a reference for assessing phenotypic outcome in the phenotype observation set.

control_type.description: Type of control (e.g., wildtype vs mutant, treated vs untreated).

vehicle_if_treated.description: The vehicle used in a control.

Control.title: Control

ControlImage.description: An image associated with a control, taken at the same developmental stage as the corresponding phenotype observation.

magnification.description: The factor by which a microscope enlarges the apparent size of a subject compared to its actual size.

phenotype_comments.description: Comments about the phenotype in the control image.

phenotype_id.description: Foreign key reference to the PhenotypeObservationSet uuid (for database representation).

resolution.description: The level of detail in the image.

scale_bar.description: Scale bar information, including the physical length it represents and the unit of measurement.

ControlImage.title: ControlImage

Experiment.description: A group of observations (phenotypic outcomes and their control) that are linked by a common exposure event and subject, and that are part of a study.

control.description: An observation that serves as the reference for assessing phenotypic outcome.

exposure_event.description: The exposure event in an experiment.

fish.description: The fish subject of the experiment.

rearing_condition_comment.description: Comments on rearing conditions, for example, about how conditions deviated from standard parameters.

standard_rearing_condition.description: An indication of whether the subject was maintained under standard conditions, which are the established, consistent environmental and husbandry parameters (such as temperature, lighting, diet, and housing) designed to minimize variability and ensure reproducibility in experiments.

Experiment.title: Experiment

ExposureEvent.description: An occurrence in a study where a subject is exposed to a stressor under defined conditions.

additional_exposure_condition.description: Additional information about the conditions under which exposure event occurred.

exposure_end_stage.description: The developmental stage of fish when exposure ended.

exposure_start_stage.description: The developmental stage of fish when exposure started.

exposure_type.description: An instance of exposure specifying the type of stressor a subject was exposed to.

phenotype_observation.description: The phenotype observation resulting from an exposure event.

stressor.description: Substance, chemical or toxicant that elicits a response (a phenotype) in a subject when encountered through exposure.

vehicle.description: The substance or medium used to deliver a stressor.

ExposureEvent.title: ExposureEvent

ExposureRegimenTypeEnum.description: An enumeration of exposure regimen types.
ExposureRegimenTypeEnum.title: ExposureRegimenTypeEnum

ExposureRoute.description:
A route-of-exposure term. Term URIs are expected to be reachable from
EXO:0000154 (route of exposure) in the EXO ontology.

term_label.description: The human-readable label for the phenotype ontology term.

term_uri.description: The URI of the phenotype ontology term.

ExposureRoute.title: ExposureRoute

term_label.description: The human-readable label for the phenotype ontology term.

term_uri.description: The URI of the phenotype ontology term.

Fish.description: A zebrafish line as the curator describes it: alleles on a wild-type background, plus any transient reagents injected into the embryos. The ZFIN ids are filled by matching the description against ZFIN's registered records (POST /api/zfin/resolve) and are absent when ZFIN has no such record.

background_name.description: The wild-type line's name as ZFIN abbreviates it, e.g. AB, TU, TL.

background_zfin_id.description: The wild-type line the fish is kept on, as ZFIN's genotype id for that line (ZDB-GENO-…). Picked from ZFIN's wild-type lines.

fish_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the registered fish this description matches (ZDB-FISH-…), when it matches one.

genotype_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the registered genotype this description matches (ZDB-GENO-…), when it matches one.

line_description.description: Free text for what the structured description cannot say: a line ZFIN has not registered, or how the fish differs from the record it matched.

mutant_allele.description: The mutant alleles the fish carries.

transgenic_allele.description: The transgenic insertions the fish carries.

transient_reagent.description: The reagents injected into the embryos.

Fish.title: Fish

FishTankEntry.description: A fish line a research group maintains. Recorded once, then reused to pre-fill curation instead of re-searching the line each time.

fish.description: The fish line the group maintains.

nickname.description: What the group calls this line, e.g. "our fli1 reporter". Optional; when given it is what the line is listed under when pre-filling a submission, and no two entries in the group may share it.

research_group.description: The research group an entry belongs to.

FishTankEntry.title: FishTankEntry

Image.description: An image associated with a phenotype observation.

image_scope.description: Whether the image shows the entire organism or only a region, organ, or structure. Phenotype annotations on a partial-organism image should be limited to what is visible in the imaged region.

magnification.description: The factor by which a microscope enlarges the apparent size of a subject compared to its actual size.

resolution.description: The level of detail in the image.

scale_bar.description: Scale bar information, including the physical length it represents and the unit of measurement.

Image.title: Image

ImageScopeEnum.description: An enumeration of how much of the organism an image shows.
ImageScopeEnum.title: ImageScopeEnum

ManufacturerEnum.description: An enumeration of manufacturers and suppliers of chemicals used in exposure events.
ManufacturerEnum.title: ManufacturerEnum

MutantAllele.description: A mutant allele the fish carries: which gene it alters, and its zygosity in the fish and, when known, the parents.

affected_gene_symbol.description: The symbol of the gene the allele affects, e.g. fgf8a.

affected_gene_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the gene the allele affects (ZDB-GENE-…).

allele_symbol.description: The allele's designation as ZFIN writes it, e.g. ti282a, fh111, w200Tg.

alteration_type.description: The kind of sequence alteration the allele is.

father_zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the father, when known.

mother_zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the mother, when known.

zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the fish. ZFIN records unknown zygosity as a value, and so does this.

MutantAllele.title: MutantAllele

OntologyEntity.description: Entities representing ontology terms with URI identifiers.
OntologyEntity.title: OntologyEntity

Phenotype.description: Any measurable or visible trait change in the subject as a result of exposure.

prevalence.description: The percentage of subject exhibiting this phenotype.

severity.description: The intensity of the observed phenotype.

stage.description: The developmental stage of fish when the phenotype was observed.

Phenotype.title: Phenotype

PhenotypeObservationSet.description: An observation set containing control and phenotypic outcome resulting from an exposure event.
PhenotypeObservationSet.title: PhenotypeObservationSet

PhenotypeTerm.description: A phenotype ontology term from the Zebrafish Phenotype ontology (ZP).

term_label.description: The human-readable label for the phenotype ontology term.

term_uri.description: The URI of the phenotype ontology term.

PhenotypeTerm.title: PhenotypeTerm

QuantityValue.description: A value of an attribute that is quantitative and measurable, expressed as a combination of a unit and a numeric value

numeric_value.description: The numeric value of the quantity value.

unit.description: The unit of the quantity value.

QuantityValue.title: QuantityValue

ReagentTypeEnum.description: The kinds of transient, sequence-targeting reagent ZFIN registers.
ReagentTypeEnum.title: ReagentTypeEnum

Regimen.description: The schedule and pattern of an exposure event.

exposure_regimen_type.description: The type of exposure regimen (e.g., continuous or repeated).

total_exposure_duration.description: Time between first and last individual exposure.

Regimen.title: Regimen

ResearchGroup.description: A named collection of users that have shared editing access.

name.description: Name or label of an entity.

ResearchGroup.title: ResearchGroup

ResearchGroupMember.description: Membership of an ORCID identity in a research group.

member.description: ORCID identifier of a research group member.

research_group.description: The research group an entry belongs to.

role.description: A member's permission level within a research group.

ResearchGroupMember.title: ResearchGroupMember

ResearchGroupRoleEnum.description: An enumeration of permission levels within a research group.
ResearchGroupRoleEnum.title: ResearchGroupRoleEnum

SequenceAlterationTypeEnum.description: The kinds of sequence alteration ZFIN records for its alleles, each with its Sequence Ontology term. The SO id is how a ZFIN record maps onto these values.
SequenceAlterationTypeEnum.title: SequenceAlterationTypeEnum

SeverityEnum.description: An enumeration of severity levels for phenotypes.
SeverityEnum.title: SeverityEnum

StressorChemical.description: A chemical that elicits a response (a phenotype) in a subject when encountered through exposure.

chemical_id.description: Chemical identifier (e.g., a CHEBI or other ontology URI) for the chemical.

concentration.description: The dose or concentration of the chemical to which the subject was exposed to.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer or supplier of the chemical.

synonym.description: Human-readable name(s) for the chemical (non-CURIE), used for display and search. The canonical identity is chemical_id.

unrecognized_chemical_name.description: Free-text name for a chemical or vehicle that could not be resolved to a standardized identifier.

unrecognized_manufacturer_name.description: Free-text name for a manufacturer or supplier that is not in the controlled ManufacturerEnum list.

StressorChemical.title: StressorChemical

Study.description: A toxicological investigation, including the experimental conditions and phenotypic outcomes, with information provenance.

annotator.description: ORCID identifier of the indidvidual submitting the study data.

description.description: A free-text summary of what the study set out to do.

lab.description: ZFIN lab identifier of the laboratory that produced the study data.

nickname.description: A short working name for the study, and what it is listed under when picking a study. Required while the study has no publication identifier; no two studies in a research group may share one.

publication.description: The persistent publication identifier (e.g., PMID, DOI) for the study. Absent while the study is unpublished, in which case its nickname identifies it instead.

research_group.description: The research group the study belongs to, whose members may edit it.

status.description: Whether a study is still being worked on or is ready to be seen. A draft is visible only to the members of its research group.

Study.title: Study

StudyStatusEnum.description: An enumeration of how far along a study is.
StudyStatusEnum.title: StudyStatusEnum

TransgenicAllele.description: A transgenic insertion the fish carries: the construct it holds, and its zygosity in the fish and, when known, the parents.

affected_gene_symbol.description: The driver or reporter gene's symbol, e.g. fli1a.

affected_gene_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the construct's driver or reporter gene, when recorded.

allele_symbol.description: The allele's designation as ZFIN writes it, e.g. ti282a, fh111, w200Tg.

alteration_type.description: The kind of alteration; a transgenic insertion unless ZFIN says otherwise.

construct_name.description: The construct's name as ZFIN writes it, e.g. Tg(mpeg1:YFP).

construct_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the transgenic construct (ZDB-TGCONSTRCT-…).

father_zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the father, when known.

mother_zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the mother, when known.

zygosity.description: The allele's zygosity in the fish. ZFIN records unknown zygosity as a value, and so does this.

TransgenicAllele.title: TransgenicAllele

TransientReagent.description: A sequence-targeting reagent injected into the embryos (a morpholino, CRISPR or TALEN). Transient and not heritable, so part of the fish and not of its genotype. Dose and injection stage belong to the experiment.

affected_gene_symbol.description: The symbol of the gene the allele affects, e.g. fgf8a.

affected_gene_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the gene the allele affects (ZDB-GENE-…).

reagent_symbol.description: The reagent's name as ZFIN writes it, e.g. MO1-fgf8a.

reagent_type.description: What kind of reagent it is.

reagent_zfin_id.description: ZFIN's id for the reagent (ZDB-MRPHLNO-, ZDB-CRISPR- or ZDB-TALEN-…).

TransientReagent.title: TransientReagent

VehicleEnum.description: An enumeration of vehicles used to deliver stressors in exposure events.
VehicleEnum.title: VehicleEnum

VehicleOfTransmission.description: The substance or medium used to deliver a stressor to a subject during an exposure event.

chemical_id.description: Chemical identifier (e.g., a CHEBI or other ontology URI) for the chemical.

concentration.description: The dose or concentration of the chemical to which the subject was exposed to.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer or supplier of the chemical.

synonym.description: Human-readable name(s) for the chemical (non-CURIE), used for display and search. The canonical identity is chemical_id.

unrecognized_chemical_name.description: Free-text name for a chemical or vehicle that could not be resolved to a standardized identifier.

unrecognized_manufacturer_name.description: Free-text name for a manufacturer or supplier that is not in the controlled ManufacturerEnum list.

vehicle_type.description: The type of vehicle used to deliver a stressor, drawn from a controlled vocabulary.

VehicleOfTransmission.title: VehicleOfTransmission

ZappEntity.description: Internal entities with auto-generated integer IDs.
ZappEntity.title: ZappEntity

ZygosityEnum.description: An allele's zygosity, in ZFIN's terms. ZFIN registers genotypes with unknown zygosity, so unknown is a value here too, and a description saying unknown matches only those genotypes.
ZygosityEnum.title: ZygosityEnum
